race.description: One Tree Inn Tuross Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: THE FRISKEE FLASH (11) is on debut for the Neil Osborne stable having trialled nicely in what was a hot trial at Goulburn recently. The wide draw is a query, but this doesn't look an overly strong maiden and she showed enough in her only trial to suggest she can run a bold race. JENNI MOO MOO (7) was good in her stable debut over a similar trip before being disappointing over further recently. Now back to 1020m looks a good move and a return to her best form can see her right in the finish. EMPTY POCKETS (6) is first-up today after going for a break on the back of a 2.2L defeat back in April. Can play a leading role in a suitable race. LOUJEN FRANCAISE (8) was better last start and can feature again.
